rules:
No illegal content.
Don't post anything that is illegal under South African law. This includes hate speech, and racism.  — If this rule seems lenient, remember that the South African constitution has a slightly different take on freedom of speech from the USA's first amendment. People can and do go to jail for discriminating against others on the basis of race, sexuality, etc (although the offenders have to work really hard to get such a harsh punishment - it's not nearly as easily as the Free Speech absolutists and the racists like to think)

No griefing, trolling, or harassment. — You're allowed to defend yourself. You're allowed to have strong opinions. But there's a line between those things, and baseless cruelty or sadism that is clear as daylight to most people. Those who like to pretend that they cannot see the line? They're the ones that this rule is aimed at.
It's not always easy to tell the difference between people who have simply been carried away by their passions, and people who take a vicious delight in harming others, so only repeat-offenders will have their accounts delete.

All admin's decisions are final. — This is a private instance. It is not a democracy. We care about people, we care about feelings, and so we try our hardest to play nice. But that won't stop us from doing whatever is necessary to protect this instance and its users (especially when the threat is coming from inside the house).

No rules lawyers — It's a sad fact that there are people who see rules like these as a challenge. Whether they're deliberately seeking to harm the instance or simply take an immature delight in testing the rules, the result tends to be people causing harm for other users, while never quite breaking the rules or doing anything harsh enough to justify expulsion.

This is why we've kept these rules vague. The management of this instance is expected to follow the spirit of them, but they do not restrict the way we manage the instance (see Rule 3). Instead, these rules are meant to give you guidance on how to be a good member of the community. Accordingly, any attempt to find or test loopholes that allow you to harm this instance and its community without technically breaking rules is doomed to failure. We'll notice, and we'll follow our own judgement.
